meta.name: openrlhf-training
meta.description: High-performance RLHF framework with Ray+vLLM acceleration. Use for PPO, GRPO, RLOO, DPO training of large models (7B-70B+). Built on Ray, vLLM, ZeRO-3. 2× faster than DeepSpeedChat with distributed architecture and GPU resource sharing.

copy.tagline: 用强化学习微调大语言模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要高效训练和优化70B以下的大语言模型。
copy.tagline_en: Fine-tune large language models with reinforcement learning
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to efficiently train and optimize large language models up to 70B parameters.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以指导你使用 OpenRLHF 框架，在 Ray 集群上对 7B 到 70B 以上的大模型进行 PPO、GRPO、RLOO、DPO 等强化学习训练，并利用 vLLM 加速推理。
howto.when: 当你需要训练大语言模型（7B-70B+）并希望使用强化学习（如 PPO、GRPO）或偏好优化（DPO）时，且你拥有多 GPU 集群（推荐 A100/H100）。

say.text: 帮我生成一个 PPO 训练脚本，使用 Llama-3-8B 模型。
如何用 GRPO 训练一个 70B 模型？
say.note: Claude 会给出 GRPO 训练命令，并说明关键参数。

say.text: 训练时遇到 GPU 显存不足怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会建议关闭模型共置或调整 vLLM 设置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you to use the OpenRLHF framework to perform RLHF training (PPO, GRPO, RLOO, DPO) on large models (7B-70B+) using a Ray cluster with vLLM inference acceleration.
howto.when_en: When you need to train large language models (7B-70B+) with reinforcement learning (e.g., PPO, GRPO) or preference optimization (DPO), and you have a multi-GPU cluster (recommended A100/H100).

say_en.text: Generate a PPO training script using Llama-3-8B.
say_en.note: Claude outputs the PPO command with Ray startup and parameters.

say_en.text: How to train a 70B model with GRPO?
say_en.note: Claude provides the GRPO command and key parameters.

say_en.text: What if I run out of GPU memory during training?
say_en.note: Claude suggests disabling model colocation or adjusting vLLM settings.
